claims.evidence: PRIDE lists exactly 25 RAW files, all with projectAccessions containing PXD004540; paper Deglycoproteome analysis: 'All raw files (n = 25: 15 fractions + 9 re-runs of late eluting fractions + 1 prefractionation sample)'

claims.value: CSF_RRMS_pool1=TMT128, CSF_RRMS_pool2=TMT130, CSF_RRMS_pool3=TMT127, CSF_OND_pool4=TMT126, CSF_OND_pool5=TMT129, CSF_OND_pool6=TMT131
claims.evidence: Paper Table 1, row 'TMT label deglycoproteome analysis': Pool 1-6 = 128, 130, 127, 126, 129, 131; Diagnosis row: Pools 1-3 RRMS, Pools 4-6 OND. The separate 'global proteome analysis' row (PXD004572) was not used.

claims.location: characteristics[disease] and factor value[disease], CSF_RRMS_pool1-3 rows
claims.evidence: Paper: 21 RRMS patients diagnosed by revised McDonald criteria, pooled into Pools 1-3; PRIDE description: '3 pools of CSF from relapsing-remitting MS (RRMS) patients'. MONDO:0005314.

claims.location: characteristics[disease] and factor value[disease], CSF_OND_pool4-6 rows
claims.evidence: Paper: '21 controls with other neurological diseases (OND)', OCB negative, no risk of MS; Pools 4-6 = OND. Individual diagnoses (Table S1) not available; broad term MONDO:0005071 chosen.
Three independent pools per group, 7 different donors each (Table 1, Figure 1A).
Each pool = equal protein amounts from 7 donors.
Table 1: each pool is 1 male / 6 female, so no single sex applies to a pool.
Only per-pool mean (SD) age at LP given in Table 1; no per-sample age; 'pooled' is rejected by the installed validator.
Human CSF collected by lumbar puncture, Haukeland University Hospital, Bergen.
Figure 1 legend: 'Only the global experiment included protein depletion'; deglycoproteome aliquots were 3 kDa filter-concentrated only.

claims.location: comment[fraction identifier], comment[technical replicate], 144 fractionated rows
claims.value: MM_n -> fraction n, technical replicate 1; MM_n_Rerun -> fraction n, technical replicate 2
claims.evidence: Paper: 15 mixed-mode fractions; fractions 7-15 reanalysed with a longer (105 min) gradient. Rerun raw header method TMT_sensitive_105min_AG_Late_Elution_Update2.meth. For these files the fraction number is the MM_n number in the file name, set by a scripted post-build patch (scratchpad/PXD004540/patch_fractions.py + fraction_map.json).

claims.location: comment[fraction identifier], comment[technical replicate], comment[fractionation method] for the 6 rows of 20150309_TMT_SPEG_50cm_90min.raw
claims.value: fraction 1, technical replicate 3, fractionation method not applicable
claims.evidence: Paper: 'Five percent of the sample was saved for prefractionation LC tandem mass spectrometry analysis' and 'n = 25: 15 fractions + 9 re-runs ... + 1 prefractionation sample'. This file is the only RAW without an MM_ fraction number in its name, and it is dated 20150309, before the 20150311 fraction series. Its header method is TMT_sensitive_90min.meth. The fraction identifier 1 is NOT taken from the file name: it is the spec convention for an unfractionated run. comment[fractionation method] = not applicable marks the run as unfractionated. Technical replicate 3 gives it its own (source, biological replicate, technical replicate) group, separate from both fractionated series. Technical replicate 1 would collide with MM_1 (same source, biological replicate, technical replicate 1, fraction 1).

Methods: 'fractionated ... using mixed-mode chromatography on a Sielc Promix MP column'. MS:1003586 checked in live OLS on 2026-10-26: label 'mixed mode chromatography', not obsolete, under MS:1002271 liquid chromatography separation. It is not a PRIDE:0000550 child, so the validator warns.

claims.value: '105 min gradient' on the 54 rerun rows; 'not available' on the other 96 rows
claims.evidence: Methods: 'since peptides in fractions 7-15 eluted very late in the gradient, those fractions were reanalyzed using a longer (105 min) gradient (Table S3)'; rerun raw method name contains '105min'. The gradient used for the initial fraction runs and the prefractionation run is not stated in the text (Table S3 unavailable). A '90min' method name is not taken as the gradient length.
Raw headers read 'Q Exactive HF - Orbitrap MS'; Methods 'Q-Exactive HF'. PRIDE structured field 'Q Exactive' (MS:1001911) is overridden.

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C fixed; TMT6plex K and peptide N-term fixed; Oxidation M, Deamidated N, Acetyl protein N-term, Glu->pyro-Glu, Gln->pyro-Glu, Ammonia-loss (N-term C) variable
claims.evidence: mzid SearchModification list (fixedMod flags and specificity rules); Methods list the first five, the N-terminal ones are the search-engine refinement defaults recorded in the mzid.
mzid Enzyme Trypsin MS:1001251, 2 missed cleavages; Methods 'in-solution trypsin digested'.

claims.location: comment[precursor mass tolerance], comment[fragment mass tolerance]
claims.evidence: mzid ParentTolerance and FragmentTolerance 10.0 ppm; Methods 'precursor and fragment mass tolerance 10 ppm'.

claims.location: comment[proteomics data acquisition method], comment[dissociation method], comment[collision energy], comment[ms2 mass analyzer], comment[ms1 scan range]
claims.evidence: Methods: data-dependent top-12, HCD at normalized collision energy 32%, MS2 at R=60,000 (Orbitrap), MS1 scan range 375-1500 m/z.

limitations: The full paper is not open access at the publisher; the accepted manuscript (postprint) from the University of Bergen archive was used. Supplementary Tables S1-S3 (per-donor data, gradients) were not available.
Individual OND control diagnoses are not known; controls are annotated with the broad MONDO term 'nervous system disorder'.
Per-donor age, sex and ancestry are not available at pool level (pool means only).
No ontology term was found for N-glycopeptide (hydrazide / SPEG) enrichment, so characteristics[enrichment process] is omitted.
comment[fractionation method] uses PSI-MS MS:1003586 (mixed mode chromatography) because PRIDE:0000550 has no mixed-mode child; parse_sdrf reports one warning (term not in the PRIDE ontology list).

Fraction identifiers for the reruns were set by a deterministic scripted post-build patch keyed on the file names, because build numbers fractions by list position. The unfractionated run keeps fraction 1 by spec convention, not from its file name.
LC gradient length is recorded only for the reruns (105 min); for the other runs it is not available.
sdrf-tools reconcile reports cleavage_agent_unsupported because the PRIDE protocol text says only 'in-solution digestion'; trypsin is stated in the paper and the mzid.
